Online Safety (Amendment)
13.  Section  24  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended, in paragraph (b) of subsection (4) of that section,
by the substitution for the words “social media account, or
internet service provider or internet intermediary on whose
online  location  such  prohibited  statement  has  been
communicated.”, of the words “social media account.”.
14.  Section  26  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended in section (1) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “the inauthentic online account”, of the words
“any  online  account”.
15.  Section  27  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows: -

(1)
in subsection (1) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “Subject to the provisions of any other
written law and the provisions of subsection (2), a
person”, of the word “Any person”;

(2)
in subsection (2) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “the internet service provider”, of the
word “service provider”; and
